note: jQuery Downgrade swaps Drupal 11's jQuery 4 for jQuery 3 (CDN 3.6.4) on selected nodes, Views pages, or themes. It has one config object jquery_downgrade.settings (keys node_ids [ints], view_routes [strings], enable_theme_downgrade [bool], downgrade_themes [strings]), one settings form at route jquery_downgrade.settings (/admin/config/development/jquery-downgrade, permission 'administer site configuration'), one OOP hook JQueryDowngradeHooks::alterAttachments() implementing hook_page_attachments_alter (unsets core/jquery, attaches jquery_downgrade/jquery_legacy), and one library jquery_legacy. No permissions of its own, no Drush, no plugin types. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real jquery_downgrade.settings config object; the module ships no config/install so baseline is empty lists.

evals.prompt: Using the jquery_downgrade module on Drupal 11, what config object holds its settings and what are the keys that decide where jQuery 3 is loaded instead of jQuery 4?
evals.expected_output: The config object is jquery_downgrade.settings, with keys node_ids (node IDs), view_routes (Views page route names), enable_theme_downgrade (bool) and downgrade_themes (theme machine names).

evals.prompt: How does the jquery_downgrade module actually replace jQuery 4 with jQuery 3 on a matching page? Which hook does it use and what does it do to the page's libraries?
evals.expected_output: Its OOP hook JQueryDowngradeHooks::alterAttachments() implements hook_page_attachments_alter(): when the current node/route/theme matches, it unsets the core/jquery library and attaches jquery_downgrade/jquery_legacy (jQuery 3.6.4 from code.jquery.com).

evals.prompt: Where is the jquery_downgrade settings form (path and permission)?
evals.expected_output: The form is at /admin/config/development/jquery-downgrade (route jquery_downgrade.settings), gated by the 'administer site configuration' permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, jquery_downgrade is configured to load jQuery 3 on one specific node. Inspect the live jquery_downgrade.settings configuration and state that node's ID.
evals.expected_output: Node 77: jquery_downgrade.settings has node_ids: [77]. Read it with drush cget jquery_downgrade.settings node_ids.

evals.prompt: On this site, is jquery_downgrade currently downgrading jQuery by node, by Views route, or by theme? Inspect the live configuration and explain which mechanism is active.
evals.expected_output: By node: jquery_downgrade.settings has node_ids set (to [77]) while view_routes is empty, enable_theme_downgrade is false and downgrade_themes is empty, so only the listed node is downgraded.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal 11 site, use the jquery_downgrade module to make node 88 load jQuery 3 instead of jQuery 4. Apply the change to the live site configuration.
evals.expected_output: jquery_downgrade.settings node_ids contains 88 (e.g. drush cset jquery_downgrade.settings node_ids.0 88 -y, or add 88 via the settings form at /admin/config/development/jquery-downgrade and save).

evals.prompt: An old script on one of my pages (the page with node id 88) breaks with the new jQuery in Drupal 11. Can you make just that one page use the older jQuery 3 instead? Apply it on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add 88 to jquery_downgrade.settings node_ids so that node's page loads jquery_downgrade/jquery_legacy (jQuery 3) instead of core/jquery.
